name: ux-review
description: UX review of a website or app through 10 UX lenses (Nielsen's heuristics, task walkthroughs, information architecture, microcopy, forms, trust, accessibility basics, mobile ergonomics, decision support, error and empty states). Delivers a visual report with friction per task step, prioritized fixes, a 5-task usability-test plan and a hands-off file for AI agents.
